bullets.text: Google Expands AI Mode - **Google**'s AI Mode now supports five new languages, enhancing global accessibility.
Polestar 5 Unveiled - The **Polestar 5** boasts 884hp and 460 miles of range, challenging luxury sedans.
Signal Introduces Backups - **Signal** launches paid and free backup options for secure messaging.
Windows 11 SSD Issues - **Phison** blames early firmware for SSD failures in recent **Windows 11** updates.
Apple's iPhone 17 Event - Anticipation builds for the **iPhone 17** launch, featuring new models and upgrades.
ReOrbit Secures Funding - **ReOrbit** raises €45 million to develop sovereign satellite solutions in Europe.
Netskope's Upcoming IPO - **Netskope** prepares for IPO, aiming for a valuation of $6.5 billion in cybersecurity.
AI-Powered FSR 4 Released - **AMD**'s FSR 4 upscaling technology is now available in most FSR 3.1 games.
Cognition AI Raises $400M - **Cognition AI** achieves a $10.2 billion valuation after a significant funding round.
Vodafone Tests AI Spokesperson - **Vodafone** introduces an AI-generated spokesperson in its advertising campaigns.
